evidence_class: Local isolated fixture in CI: real files in pytest temporary execution roots laid out by SV2-FSY-01 and a temporary cache store with the shipped policy; fake clock and fake disk usage; trusted toolchain entry, poisoned executable entry, full disk and mismatched dependency lock. Nothing mocked except monkeypatched copy and write failures in named failure tests. Not live rollout proof.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.cache.Key(kind, toolchain, lock, platform, scope).digest(): one entry name per full key
scripts.swarm_v2.cache.lock_digest(path): sha256 of a dependency lock file, the lock field of a key
scripts.swarm_v2.cache.load(path) -> Policy: enabled, store, kinds, executable kinds, excluded names, byte budget, free space reserve and shared scope from docker/swarm-node/cache-policy.json
scripts.swarm_v2.cache.Store(policy, scope, clock, usage): a store bound to the attempt's granted scope

scripts.swarm_v2.cache.attach(store, execution, key) -> Layer(key, seed, writable): a private writable layer under the attempt's tmp/cache and, on a hit, a sealed read only seed; unsound entries discarded
scripts.swarm_v2.cache.publish(store, execution, layer) -> seed path or None: copies a writable layer in as a new seed within budget and reserve; CacheError for every refusal

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.filesystem: POSIX rename, chmod and flock on the ubuntu-latest CI runner

states.observed: Entries, records and modes inside the pytest temporary cache store and execution roots
states.accepted: An entry whose recorded key and file manifest match the requested key and its files
states.committed: A seed renamed into place under its key digest after staging, sealed read only
states.externally_verified: None; no worker launch path calls the module yet

red: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38058634806 on c98891da: tests only commit, cache module missing at collection
validation.mutation: Branch preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38067627041 succeeded on 7f65a6b31b437bdf07ddca272d6b78a7690fad62; earlier preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38059851797 graded cache.py 387 killed, 0 survived
validation.review: Standards and Spec readers ran three rounds and closed; held items recorded under remaining_limitations
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; lint, format and size passed in the pre push gate on every head

measurements.cache_hit_rate: share of attaches that found a seed; case A asserts reuse by the second attempt
measurements.cache_corruption_total: count of entries discarded on attach; case C asserts exactly one after damage

rollback_rehearsal.action: policy enabled false: attach returns no seed, publish writes nothing, store, workspace, home and archive untouched

scope: Cache keys, private writable layers, sealed seeds, bounded disk use and corrupt entry recovery at the module interface; worker launch wiring belongs to later packages
remaining_limitations: The granted scope is passed in by the caller, so the toolchain rejection holds at this interface only.
No worker launch path calls the module yet.
Seeds are sealed by file mode only; a seed edited after an attach runs unverified for that holder until the next attach discards it. An owner separated or read only store mount is a ledger follow up.

T-SV2-FSY-03-A.title: successful behavior: two compatible tasks reuse a dependency cache while keeping native conversations and credentials separate

T-SV2-FSY-03-B.title: rejection: a cache from an untrusted project cannot replace executable toolchain content in another scope

T-SV2-FSY-03-C.title: recovery: corrupt cache content is discarded and rebuilt without deleting the task's source changes

completion_evidence: Fixture qualified only; the package is not complete until a worker launch path uses the module and a rollout gate verifies it live.
compatibility: No preceding cache protocol exists; with reuse off every attempt behaves as the local path does today, a fresh layer with no seed
authority: The writable scope comes from the Store's granted scope, never from a key field or display label
